🦎 Welcome to Hatch & Habitats!

Build your dream reptile store! Care for realistic animals, create beautiful habitats, and decorate your shop your way.

🌿 Design habitats for your reptiles
🥚 Discover new animals and grow your collection
🏪 Build and expand your reptile store

Join Habitat Crew for updates, sneak peeks, and community events!

🚧 In development—features may change as the game grows.
